name: We Go On Tour-Chicago, IL
address: The Den Theatre, 1331 North Milwaukee Avenue Chicago, IL 60622
description: Get ready for an immersive experience through Grief to Hope as the We Go On Tour comes back to Chicago! The evening is designed to help you hold on to hope during times that seem to make it so slippery and take the next step toward healing. We’ve learned that sometimes the smallest steps are the most important ones. So, we curated a safe space for you to talk (and laugh) about the uncomfortable, intimidating, and sometimes scary topic: Grief. Our time together will be filled with live music, film, and conversation. Come experience a sense of both anticipation and freedom and leave with a wealth of hope.

This in-person event is a great opportunity to engage in meaningful conversations and gain deeper understanding of the challenges and opportunities facing our democracy with some of the most respected and insightful minds in the country.

name: YPN Breakfast: Mentally Managing the Real Estate Rollercoaster
address: Manny's Coffee Shop & Deli, 1141 South Jefferson Street Chicago, IL 60607
description: Start your day with business advice, compelling discussions and new connections at our monthly meet-ups. Enjoy a complimentary breakfast while you catch up with your YPN friends and grow your business. This month, we’re talking about mental wellness! Working in real estate can feel like a rollercoaster, with rapid ups and downs that require managing rejection and celebrating successes within the span of just a single day. We love this industry, and one of the best sources of support for our mental wellness is leaning on our peers. During this special, interactive breakfast, we’re going to talk about how to take vacations and truly check out, build stronger emotional management strategies, set and hold boundaries and prevent burnout. Come prepared for active table discussions throughout the whole event.
